messages:
maria: Heads up — planning to spin up model_v4 for Europe/NA in a staged audience test. Need someone to pin/unpin the feature flag for region-specific percent ramps. Will follow this thread for handoff.

raj: I can do the flips. What's the initial % and guardrails?

maria: Start at 3% NA + 3% EU, then 15% after 1h if SLOs good. Guardrails: 95th latency < 350ms, error rate < 0.5%, no regressions in our eval set. If any alert fires, revert to previous pinned variant.

kevin: @raj FYI the console UI has 'audience override' — I can cut NA/EU only. I'll need the exact flag key and annotation.

maria: Flag key: `feature.model_inference.v4.audience` — use `scope=region:na|eu percentage=3` Comment with PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/482

kevin: Got it. I'll do NA first. @deploy-bot can we get a dry-run log? Also tagging @liz for QA on prompt set 7.

deploy-bot: dry-run OK — simulated rollout would create 3% traffic slice for NA, no infra changes. Command example:
```
rctl feature set model_v4 --scope region=na --percent 3 --note "staged test"
```

liz: I'll run eval set 7 within 10 mins once % is up. Quick check: do we want live A/B logging turned on? need it for diff metrics.

maria: Yes enable `a_b_diffs=true` for these slices. Keep logs for 2h. Also enable the regression alert on 'prompt-clarity' metric.

raj: I'm standing by to flip. If all green at 1h, bump to 15% NA, 10% EU. If regressions, I'll pin back to v3 and roll out an incident.

kevin: Flipping now for NA -> 3%... done. Console event id: evt-20260317-01. @liz you should see traffic routed.

liz: Traffic visible. Running evals... initial metrics look okay, 95p latency 320ms, error 0.12%. No hallucination spikes so far.

maria: Awesome. Track in the rollout doc: https://docs.redwood.com/rollouts/model_v4. Add any anomalies here. Keep thread open for rollback pings.

raj: Will schedule EU flip in 15min. Also adding a temporary region-override: `eu_cold_start=on` to mitigate mem pressure.

kevin: Noted. Tagging @oncall for awareness — oncall: any concerns with increased KV cache from new model?

oncall-bot: oncall rotation: sam oncall for next 24h. Sam: please monitor cache usage. Alert if > 80% for > 5min.
